title: Representing the Non-dominated Set of Multi-objective Network Problems by Supported Non-dominated Points
summary: In multi-objective combinatorial optimization, unsupported non-dominated points typically outnumber supported points and are often significantly more challenging to compute. Recent studies show that extreme supported non-dominated points provide high-quality representations of the non-dominated set for certain binary problems.
